parse.title: Deer-tan
parse.text:
Limited Unit
This unit is only available for a short time!

Overview

Deer-tan is a Exclusive Limited unit. She is a Tournament-exclusive (preceding Julias), only obtainable by clearing the tournament on the 99.00% ~ 99.89% ranking reward, with her shiny being the 99.90% ~ 100% ranking reward.

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
